title: Fattah AgentGuard Alert
description: Structured alert emitted by a detection rule. Every detection (atomic or correlation) outputs an object matching this schema. The `evidence` array holds one item for atomic alerts and multiple items (the chain steps) for correlation alerts.

alert_id.description: Unique handle: FAG-0001 for the replayed dataset, FAG-L0001 for live-ingested events.

rule_id.description: Use case that fired: T1-T5 built in, T6+ created in the dashboard.

threat_category.description: Human-readable threat name. REQUIRED by assignment (threat category).

owasp.description: OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025) category, e.g. 'LLM01 Prompt Injection'.

mitre.description: MITRE ATLAS / ATT&CK mapping. REQUIRED by assignment.

framework.description: Which framework the primary technique is from.

also.description: Optional secondary mappings (e.g. the ATT&CK ID alongside the ATLAS one, or chain-step techniques).

timestamp.description: When the triggering activity occurred (timestamp of the last/triggering event).

detected_at.description: When the engine raised the alert (ingest/processing time).

session_id.description: Session the alert belongs to. The dashboard filters on this.

user.description: Developer the agent acted on behalf of.

evidence.description: The offending log evidence. One item for atomic alerts; the ordered chain steps for correlation alerts. REQUIRED by assignment (raw evidence snippet).

source.description: Where the evidence came from (file path, URL, prompt source).

snippet.description: Raw excerpt of the offending content, taken verbatim from the log event.

step.description: For correlation alerts: which chain stage this is, e.g. 'injection', 'secret_read', 'exfil'.

recommended_action.description: Immediate response the SOC should take. REQUIRED by assignment.

response_taken.description: Action taken by the Mini SOAR: 'quarantine_logged' (TP), 'closed_false_positive' (FP), 'closed_benign_positive' (BP), or 'quarantine_logged; held_for_analyst_review' (BP/FP on a Critical/chain alert, guardrail).

triage.description: Added by the triage stage. Label-free classification: signals -> confidence -> verdict. Explains WHY an alert is a true or false positive.

effect.description: points added to / removed from confidence

owasp_agentic.description: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026) mapping, e.g. 'ASI01 Agent Goal Hijack'.

status.description: Lifecycle. new = raised (TP awaiting analyst); held_for_review = guardrail kept a low-confidence Critical/chain alert open; closed = closed by the Mini SOAR as benign/false positive. Active alerts = status != closed.
